purpose: Startup wiring probe: one genuine and one cloned clip from the speaker-disjoint val split, with the P(fake) this pipeline returns for each. Assert both, not just one -- a probe that only checks a negative passes when the model is loaded upside down.
how_to_score: ml.infer.read_audio(path) -> L1Scorer.score_waves([wav])[0]. score_waves centre-crops to crop_s, so the whole file goes in.
determinism: Bit-identical over 5 runs and across cuda/cpu on the reference box; the 0.01 tolerance is headroom for a different GPU or torch build, not observed drift.
